description: Process a holds a snapshot and a dynaset over table L (ID, MEMO) and has read row 1 of each. Process b replaces the memo of row 2 by a 9,000-character value, replaces the long memo of row 4 by a short value, deletes row 3 and reinserts it with a 7,000-character memo. Process a continues to the end of each cursor reading the memos, MoveFirst and reads again, then Requery and reads. Asks which memo values, row membership and errors the held cursors return.
retentionNote: Designed r-lock-3-4-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
